movie_title: What happens when you have a concussion? - Clifford Robbins

vocabulary.definition: a temporary unconsciousness or confusion caused by a blow to the head
vocabulary.example: He suffered a concussion during the football game and had to be taken to the hospital.

vocabulary.definition: long, slender projections of a nerve cell that conduct electrical impulses away from the cell body
vocabulary.example: The damaged axons in his brain resulted in communication issues and memory loss.

vocabulary.definition: to deteriorate or decline in quality or strength
vocabulary.example: The disease caused his muscles to degenerate over time, leading to mobility issues.

vocabulary.definition: referring to impacts to the head that are below the threshold of causing a concussion
vocabulary.example: The study focused on the long-term effects of subconcussive hits in soccer players.

vocabulary.definition: tiny tubes within a nerve cell that provide structure and support for the cell
vocabulary.example: The researchers observed how the damage to microtubules affected the overall function of the nerve cells.
Despite his injuries, he felt invincible and continued to push himself beyond his limits.
